correctness.rationale: The p=3 contradiction is independently reproduced by the numerical-semigroup model; the offset-semigroup equivalence and prime-power modular bound have direct proofs, with computational checks against published exact values.

originality.rationale: The current source and synonymous/equivalent searches revealed no correction of Theorem 10.7 or prior statement of the prime-power Carmichael extension. Older Zenkin full texts were not fully inspected and remain an explicit residual risk for the semigroup viewpoint.

value.rationale: Corrects a false universal theorem in a recent preprint while preserving its intended p>=5 bound and p=11 corollary, and supplies a structural semigroup mechanism with a broader prime-power extension.
